reasoning: The claim that generative AI "will replace" 300 million jobs worldwide is a misleading overstatement of the actual source study. This figure originates from a March 2023 report by Goldman Sachs, which estimated that generative AI *could expose* the equivalent of 300 million full-time jobs globally to automation. Crucially, the report did not state that these jobs would be definitively eliminated or replaced. Instead, it argued that while about two-thirds of current jobs are exposed to some degree of AI automation, most of those occupations will be complemented rather than substituted by AI. Representing a projection of "automation exposure" as a definitive prediction of outright job replacement distorts the study's actual findings.
